About CVN Fiber

Transforming agricultural waste into sustainable wealth.

CVN Fiber was established with a vision to reutilize one of the most abundant agricultural resources, the banana stem, and convert it into valuable, eco-friendly products. Founded by Sirisha Devi and Sravanthi, the company combines sustainability, rural livelihood creation and practical material innovation.

Our Story
Waste to value. Creating useful products while supporting farmers and rural communities.
Our Story

A simple idea with a wider purpose.

What was once treated as farm waste can become material, livelihood and value.

SD
Sirisha Devi Co-Founder
S
Sravanthi Co-Founder

CVN Fiber recognized the potential hidden in banana stem residue and set out to create sustainable solutions that benefit farmers, empower rural communities and contribute to environmental conservation.

Through innovative processing, banana stems that would otherwise be discarded are transformed into meaningful, higher-value products. The approach is designed not only around material recovery, but around building a practical circular economy closer to the source of agricultural production.

The company works with the belief that sustainability should create value across the chain: for farmers through additional income opportunities, for rural communities through livelihoods, and for industries and consumers through useful eco-friendly products.

What Drives Us

Sustainability that creates practical value.

CVN Fiber's purpose extends beyond producing banana fiber. The company is building a model in which agricultural residue can support livelihoods, resource efficiency and environmentally responsible products.

Environmental Responsibility

Reducing agricultural waste by creating useful products from banana stem residue.

Value for Farmers

Creating an additional source of value from banana stem residues that may otherwise be discarded.

Rural Livelihoods

Generating employment opportunities for rural women and supporting skill-based sustainable livelihoods.

Circular Economy

Creating a cycle in which agricultural residue is transformed into material, farm inputs and food products.

What We Create

More value from every banana stem.

CVN Fiber uses banana stems to create multiple product streams, helping extend the value of agricultural biomass beyond the original crop.

01

Raw Banana Fiber

Natural fiber for textile, handicraft, packaging and industrial applications.

02

Organic Liquid Fertilizer

Nutrient-rich liquid input intended to support sustainable farming practices.

03

Vermicompost

Organic manure that supports soil fertility and healthy crop growth.

04

Fiber-Rich Food Products

Food applications using the edible, fiber-rich parts of the banana stem.

Our Social Impact

Building value beyond the product.

CVN Fiber's model connects environmental responsibility with social empowerment. By working closer to farming communities, the company aims to reduce waste while creating new economic opportunities.
